name: case-file-builder
description: Build the Case File (.md) for one Augusta project from its linked GitHub repos and Fireflies calls, in the Case Studies Gold Standard structure: fourteen sections, every fact sourced and dated, every stated figure recorded and graded, empty fields left empty and turned into asks. Use when asked to build, refresh or check the case file of a row in the Project Tracker; not for writing slides, cards or any case-study format, which are generated from the file later.
